title: E22 caravan trials, redone with a trade depot (user, 17 Sep: without a depot the caravan parks at the edge and leaves, so the merchants never cross the map). A 5x5 trade depot is placed on flat ground beside a citizen, supplied with the three logs from the embark wagon and completed with build-now (stage 3/3 instantly, verified by hand) before anything else; then small prey open, the dwarven caravan forced on the first prey wave with the predator entries opened, predators gathered and PREDATOR_OR_PREY written 3,000 ticks later and every 1,500 ticks. Two trials, levers armed.
fork: v5.6 safety: do armed predators attack merchants or pack animals on their way to and from the depot.

predictions.model: the relation is pairwise between wild units only
predictions.expects: merchants, pack animals and migrants never appear in a predator's combat reports beyond the control's rate; megabeast arrival leaves arrivals and departures unchanged
lever arms show merchant, pack-animal or citizen combat and deaths the controls do not

kill_criterion: a merchant or pack-animal death, or a predator combat report naming one, while the caravan travels to or from the depot
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save
drop a replicate whose depot check does not read 1 complete

arms.name: caravan_depot_lever
pre: local site=df.world_site.find(df.global.plotinfo.site_id); local x0,x1=math.floor(site.global_min_x/16),math.floor(site.global_max_x/16); local y0,y1=math.floor(site.global_min_y/16),math.floor(site.global_max_y/16); local o,c=0,0; for _,p in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local r=p.population; if p.type==df.world_population_type.Animal and r.feature_idx<0 and r.cave_id<0 and r.region_x>=x0-1 and r.region_x<=x1+1 and r.region_y>=y0-1 and r.region_y<=y1+1 and p.quantity_max<10000000 then local cr=df.creature_raw.find(p.race); local id=cr and cr.creature_id or ''; if (id=='PORCUPINE' or id=='ECHIDNA' or id=='BADGER' or id=='WOMBAT' or id=='BIRD_EMU') then p.quantity=30; p.flags.extinct=false; o=o+1 else p.quantity=0; p.flags.extinct=true; c=c+1 end end end; print(('opened %d entries at 30 (PORCUPINE ECHIDNA BADGER WOMBAT BIRD_EMU); closed %d'):format(o,c))

local cz; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isCitizen(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) then cz=u break end end if not cz then print('depot: no citizen found') return end local function free_item(it) if it.flags.in_job or it.flags.construction or it.flags.forbid or it.flags.garbage_collect or it.flags.on_fire then return false end if it.flags.in_inventory then return false end return true end local mats={} for _,it in ipairs(df.global.world.items.all) do local t=it:getType() if (t==df.item_type.BOULDER or t==df.item_type.WOOD or t==df.item_type.BLOCKS) and free_item(it) and it.pos.z==cz.pos.z then mats[#mats+1]=it; if #mats==3 then break end end end if #mats<3 then for _,it in ipairs(df.global.world.items.all) do local t=it:getType(); if (t==df.item_type.BOULDER or t==df.item_type.WOOD or t==df.item_type.BLOCKS) and free_item(it) then local dup=false; for _,m in ipairs(mats) do if m.id==it.id then dup=true end end; if not dup then mats[#mats+1]=it end; if #mats==3 then break end end end end if #mats<3 then print('depot: only '..#mats..' free building items on the map') return end local function flat(x,y,z) for dx=0,4 do for dy=0,4 do local p=xyz2pos(x+dx,y+dy,z); if not dfhack.maps.isValidTilePos(p) then return false end local tt=dfhack.maps.getTileType(p); if not tt then return false end local a=df.tiletype.attrs[tt] if df.tiletype_shape[a.shape]~='FLOOR' or df.tiletype_material[a.material]=='TREE' then return false end local b=dfhack.maps.getTileBlock(p); local occ=b.occupancy[p.x%16][p.y%16] if occ.building~=0 or b.designation[p.x%16][p.y%16].flow_size>0 then return false end end end return true end local z=cz.pos.z; local found for r=0,40 do for dx=-r,r do for dy=-r,r do if not found and (math.abs(dx)==r or math.abs(dy)==r) then local x,y=cz.pos.x+dx,cz.pos.y+dy; if flat(x,y,z) then found={x=x,y=y} end end end end; if found then break end end if not found then print('depot: no flat 5x5 near citizen', cz.id, cz.pos.x, cz.pos.y, z) return end local bld,err=dfhack.buildings.constructBuilding{type=df.building_type.TradeDepot, pos=xyz2pos(found.x,found.y,z), width=5, height=5, items=mats} if not bld then print('depot: constructBuilding failed: '..tostring(err)) return end local ok,e2=pcall(dfhack.run_command,'build-now') local ids={} for _,m in ipairs(mats) do ids[#ids+1]=df.item_type[m:getType()]..'#'..m.id end print(('depot: trade depot %d planned at %d,%d,%d (5x5) near citizen %d with items %s; build-now -> %s %s; stage %s/%s'):format(bld.id, found.x, found.y, z, cz.id, table.concat(ids,' '), tostring(ok), tostring(e2), tostring(bld:getBuildStage()), tostring(bld:getMaxBuildStage())))

local n,done=0,0; for _,b in ipairs(df.global.world.buildings.all) do if b:getType()==df.building_type.TradeDepot then n=n+1; if b:getBuildStage()==b:getMaxBuildStage() then done=done+1 end end end; print(('depot check: %d trade depot(s), %d complete'):format(n,done))
